Page and deck work: a landing, portfolio, article or event page, or an HTML presentation, is built with the `page-studio` skill and the `studio_*` tools — load the skill before composing, because it carries the manifest and the field tables. Default: one page in the Quiet look, at most three questions with a default each, and a target folder taken from the user's request or the project's own conventions — ask only when neither names one. Not a design interview, and not a framework project: everything is offline and static, with no server, no external asset, no PDF.
